reason: Provides agent-facing HTTP(S) fetching through a configured proxy and a proxy diagnostics tool, making search and web browsing the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的 HTTP 代理抓取网页、文档和 API 内容，并提供代理配置与连通性诊断工具。
summaries.en: Fetches web pages, documents, and API responses through a configured HTTP proxy and provides proxy configuration and reachability diagnostics.

capabilities: Performs outbound HTTP and HTTPS requests through a configured proxy
Retrieves remote response content with redirects, timeouts, and size limits
Reads proxy configuration from parameters, environment variables, and Windows system settings
Reports proxy reachability and effective proxy configuration
